record.question: According to the World's Bank Survey conducted by Forbes Magazine the bank ranked top by the customers in India is:
record.explanation: Answer C: HDFC Bank. The source’s cited customer survey places HDFC Bank highest among the listed Indian banks. This is a survey ranking, not an objective measure of bank quality. Reference: https://www.forbes.com/lists/worlds-best-banks/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
